text: Client liaisons are the front desk: booking, checking out and taking payments. Anything that reverses money or a membership goes to the lead.
The one thing to remember: client liaisons book, check out and take payments. Voids, account credits, membership cancellations and bank deposits belong to the lead client liaison.
This is Lou, a client liaison.
Booking, new clients, Room Loaders, tasks and forward booking are right here. There's no Create deposit.
Lou sees the payment, but there's no Void.
Lou sees appointment, communication, membership and patient reports. No payments.
Now Dana, our lead client liaison. She has Create deposit.
adds the financial reports, starting with payments.
A lead client liaison can also cancel or change a membership, issue gift cards, reopen an invoice, and manage message templates and CL seats in Settings.
The most common mistake is giving a client liaison the lead role just to void one payment. Ask the lead, or grant that one permission for a set time.
Remember: client liaisons book, check out and take payments. Reversing money or memberships belongs to the lead.
